Container.Name: World Monitor AIO (Unofficial)
Container.Overview: Unofficial all-in-one self-hosted World Monitor global intelligence dashboard with its local API, private Valkey cache, optional AIS relay, and scheduled data seeders.
Container.Description: Runs World Monitor, its local API, authenticated Valkey, Redis REST adapter, optional AIS relay, and data seeder scheduler in one container. Only the web port is published. World Monitor has no built-in authentication; keep it LAN/VPN-only unless it is protected by an authenticated reverse proxy.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: world monitor geopolitics intelligence dashboard news maps self hosted
Container.Requires: Unraid 6.12 or newer on AMD64. Approximately 1 GB Docker image space and 4 GB available RAM are recommended for initial seeding. Outbound HTTPS is required. LAN or VPN access only unless protected by external authentication.
Container.Changes: 2026-07-23: Initial beta AIO release based on World Monitor 2.10.0.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: World Monitor HTTP interface. Change the host port if 3300 is already in use.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Generated internal secrets, Valkey data, and seeder state. Use a dedicated directory.

Config.Name: Seed on startup
Config.Description: Run the upstream data seeders after startup.

Config.Name: Seed interval minutes
Config.Description: Minutes between seed passes. Set to 0 to disable recurring seeding.

Config.Name: Per-seeder timeout seconds
Config.Description: Maximum runtime for eligible individual seeders. Set to 0 to disable the outer timeout.

Config.Name: Redis memory limit
Config.Description: Maximum Redis cache memory inside the container.

Config.Name: Cloudflare API token
Config.Description: Optional Cloudflare Radar data; account access may be restricted or paid.

Config.Name: ACLED email
Config.Description: Optional ACLED account email when required by the upstream API.

Config.Name: ACLED password
Config.Description: Optional ACLED account password when required by the upstream API.

Config.Name: LLM model
Config.Description: Optional model name for the compatible endpoint.
